description: Security profile for Manage Business Partner (F3163)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Admin
scopes.description: Open and maintain the MDM Configuration Panel

role-templates.name: BusinessPartnerViewer
role-templates.description: Read-only access to business partner master data

role-templates.name: BusinessPartnerManager
role-templates.description: Full access to business partner master data

role-templates.name: DataSteward
role-templates.description: Configure the duplicate check. Deliberately separate from BusinessPartnerManager: changing what counts as a duplicate is a control, not master data maintenance

role-templates.name: Admin
role-templates.description: MDMLIGHT - Administrator. Opens the MDM Configuration Panel: quality, duplicate and workflow rules, field property profiles and the AI switch. Deliberately NOT the DataSteward role template, which is what data-stewards.js resolves into the workflow's data steward step - configuring the controls and reviewing a request are different jobs
